dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-lateral flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from dark outer perimeters to lighter, high-intensity interior centers. Most prominent are three circular rings forming a cluster in the central-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid pale pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the dorsal-lateral transition zone and interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form a distinct scalene triangle mid-body, while secondary blob centroids create an irregular polygonal pattern extending towards the posterior dorsal line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly distinct artificial brand or temporal mark on the left anterior shoulder/neck region consisting of five vertically oriented, parallel linear scars of high-intensity pale tissue, resembling an alphanumeric sequence.
